## Change

Describe the problem, resulting behavior, and any API or migration changes.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. For component changes, cover public React behavior with unit tests and relevant Storybook interactions/accessibility checks. Run the Storybook build and package-content check. Explain changes to dependencies or the public API.

## Release

State whether this PR should ship a new package version. If so, include the version, regenerate the lockfile and commit any resulting changes, and add migration notes for breaking changes. Documentation-only maintenance does not need a release.
